feature.label: PLS-SEM Sample Size and Power Analysis

claim.supported_scope: Planned simulation-based prospective power and minimum-sample-size analysis for a frozen bounded family of recursive PLS structural models and explicitly declared data-generating assumptions.
claim.estimand: The probability that a preregistered supported PLS inferential procedure rejects its null under a specified effect, sample size, model, and data-generating design.
assumptions: The model shape, effect values, indicator distributions, reliability, significance level, and inference procedure are explicitly specified.
Power applies only to the simulated design grid and inferential procedure shown in the result.
Indexed random streams and a fixed stopping rule make repeated calculations reproducible.
exclusions: The inverse-square-root and ten-times heuristics are not presented as general power guarantees.
Unspecified formative, higher-order, multigroup, nonlinear, mixture, and missing-data designs are excluded.
A recommended sample size is not a guarantee of model convergence, external validity, or adequate data quality.
warnings: Power is conditional on the declared data-generating assumptions and target test.
Extrapolation outside the simulated sample-size and effect grid is not supported.

equations.expression: power_hat(n, theta) = sum_r I(p_r <= alpha) / R
n_min = min{n in N_grid : lower_confidence_bound(power_hat(n)) >= target_power}

references.citation: Muthen and Muthen (2002), How to Use a Monte Carlo Study to Decide on Sample Size and Determine Power
Planned independent Python data generator and binomial power calculator
Planned published worked scenario with fully specified structural effects, loadings, alpha, and target power

simulations.design: Null structural effects across the supported sample-size, indicator-reliability, and distribution grid.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed streams shared only by scenario identity, never execution order or worker count.
simulations.acceptance_rule: At alpha 0.05 the preregistered confidence interval must contain 0.05, its upper bound must not exceed 0.065, and supported-scope convergence must be at least 0.99.

simulations.design: Known nonzero path effects across monotone sample-size grids and supported reliability/distribution settings.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed streams with common random numbers across candidate sample sizes where mathematically valid.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The selected minimum sample size must be conservative against an independently generated validation run and must meet the target-power lower confidence bound.

simulations.design: Small, ill-conditioned, weakly identified, and high-missingness cases adjacent to the supported boundary.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen indexed streams with all failed replicates retained in denominators and diagnostics.
simulations.acceptance_rule: No failed replicate may be silently discarded; unsupported designs must be blocked before simulation.

boundaries.case: The declared indicator covariance or structural design is singular or ill-conditioned.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The setup is blocked or the affected replicate is counted and reported under the frozen failure policy.

boundaries.case: The requested model contains an unqualified interaction, mixture, higher-order, or multigroup shape.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The setup is blocked before execution with the exact unsupported feature identified.

boundaries.case: Constructs and indicators are consistently reordered without changing the design.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped power estimates and confidence intervals remain equal within the frozen tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same design is executed with different supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Replicate plans, outcomes, aggregate power, and selected sample size are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: The design grid, seed, replicate count, achieved-power row, or method identity is altered after execution.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive rather than displaying the changed recommendation.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose stable capability identity differs from its recipe.
Reject a result relabeled as another power-analysis version.
Reject a data-based design whose saved dataset fingerprint no longer matches.
Reject any modified archive entry whose checksum no longer matches.
Reject duplicated keys, unknown fields, non-finite values, inconsistent grids, or invalid denominators.
Never reinterpret heuristic or preview output as a current simulation-based power result.

persistence.legacy_policy: No heuristic or preview sample-size artifact qualifies as simulation-based v1 evidence.

setup_controls: Target structural path or supported test
applicability_blockers: Unachievable precision for the requested replicate count
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same design, seed, method version, and settings, GUI and CLI replicate plans and analytical payloads must be exactly equal apart from operational timestamps.
accessibility_rules: The power curve has an equivalent accessible data table.
Assumptions, failures, and the sample-size recommendation are available without color or pointer interaction.
